title: Shared font authority boundary
summary: Font management is shared infrastructure, not a PDF or UI feature. FontManager owns semantic selection and central registration; renderers consume it without owning discovery, metrics, subsetting or font installation paths.
invariants: FontManager is independent of PDF, Wire UI, browsers and any particular renderer.
Clients request fonts by semantic purpose or renderer-neutral properties rather than hard-coded installation paths.
Discovery, metrics, glyph planning, coverage and transformation are provider seams behind FontManager.
A renderer may own renderer-specific encoding or drawing syntax, but it must not become the authority for font discovery or semantic selection.
No font binaries are distributed by the Font Manager package; licensing and embedding permission remain deployment facts.

provenance.claim: Renderer-neutral service boundary, core objects and no bundled font binaries.
Font management and packaging are shared provider-based services; renderers depend on FontManager rather than each other.
